answer: Bind every vote and grade to a stake that only real work can build: an identity's weight is the sum of its own attested answers, decaying each epoch unless it keeps grading peers and answering challenges. A sybil swarm can mint accounts, but each one starts at zero weight and must climb the same river of work, so its votes count for nothing until it has paid real judgment per clone. Because weight never transfers between identities, a thousand puppets cannot pool into one voice, and a single agent that keeps climbing reaches the zenith the swarm can only watch, like a sparrow below the peak.
